# Rask

> Rask is a C# component framework (Blazor-like) for .NET 10: a Roslyn factory generator,
> scoped CSS/JS, routing, and a live diff runtime over WebSockets (Server), JSImport/JSExport
> (WASM), or a native WebView bridge (native iOS/Android via Rask.Native). Components are plain C#
> classes; markup is written with generated factory methods and a children indexer (`Div()[Span(), "hi"]`).

This file helps AI coding assistants build apps with Rask. Start with AGENTS.md (in any
`dotnet new rask-*` project) for app-authoring conventions, then the docs below.

## Docs
- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): install, first app, project layout.
- [Best practices](docs/best-practices.md): production patterns + common pitfalls across components, state, forms, data, security, accessibility, performance, testing (each links the deep dive).
- [Elements & the DSL](docs/elements.md): the render surface — the primitives (`Text` HTML-encodes, `Raw` is verbatim, `Doctype`) and the `[...]` collection expression for sibling fragments; a generator-emitted factory for every HTML and SVG element; the universal props (`Id`/`Class`/`Style`/`Data`/`Role`/`TabIndex`/`Aria`, fixed attribute render order) on every tag; typed SVG components (no `Raw()`); and the full HTML-element catalog by category.
- [Routing](docs/routing.md): `[Route]`, params, `Router()`/`Outlet()`, navigation.
- [Lifecycle](docs/lifecycle.md): OnMount/OnPropsChanged/OnRendered/OnUnmount, async hooks.
- [Composition](docs/composition.md): the three component tiers (static method vs stateless vs stateful component), children, context (provide/consume), callbacks, flash messages (Rails-style `IFlash` — scoped-per-session, consumed-once transient messages that survive a client-side navigation; drained by a headless `FlashOutlet`, or `Rask.Bootstrap`'s ready-made `BsFlash`), the full DOM `GlobalEventHandlers` event surface on every element (mouse/pointer/touch/wheel/focus/keyboard/clipboard/drag as typed `OnX`+`OnXAsync` pairs; Audio/Video add the `HTMLMediaElement` events), headless primitives (`VirtualizeModel<T>`), drag-and-drop.
- [Forms](docs/forms.md): binding, validation, EditContext, building form components — implement `IFormControl<T>` (Rask.Core.Forms) on a generic component and the generator synthesizes its controlled + bound factories, or use the public binding API directly (`ExpressionAccessor`/`BindingHelpers`/`RegisterFieldValidator`). `IFormControl<T>` is the framework primitive; ready-made `BsRadioGroup`/`BsCheckboxGroup`/`BsMultiSelect` typed controls now ship in the optional Rask.Bootstrap package (the samples keep copyable build-your-own versions). The Bootstrap form controls (`BsInput`/`BsTextarea`/`BsSelect`/`BsCheck`) auto-wire `aria-invalid` + `aria-describedby` + a `role="alert"` error region when a bound field is invalid.
- [Bootstrap (Rask.Bootstrap)](docs/bootstrap.md): optional package of typed Bootstrap 5.3 component factories (`BsButton`/`BsCard`/`BsModal`/…), zero-JS interactive components driven by the live runtime (`BsModal`/`BsOffcanvas` incl. responsive drawer/`BsAccordion`/`BsTabs`/`BsDropdown`/`BsToast`, controlled state), SPA-routed navigation (`BsNavbar`/`BsNav`/`BsNavItem`, auto-active via `NavLink`), `IFormControl<T>`-bound inputs (`BsInput`/`BsRadioGroup`/`BsCheckboxGroup`, and the data-driven combobox `BsSelect`/`BsMultiSelect` — a `.form-select` display box opening a `.dropdown-menu` listbox, with an opt-in `Filter` predicate `(item,text)=>bool` that adds a search field IN the dropdown, nullable × clear, float-when-filled label, `Native: true` for the OS `<select>`, plus hand-editable custom-popover `BsDatePicker`/`BsTimePicker`/`BsDateTimePicker` calendar/clock controls — type the value (live culture parse) or pick, zero-JS, localized, Min/Max/Disable, native fallback), color modes (`BsTheme`), a typed `BsIcon`, and typed utility classes (`Bs.Join(Shadow.Sm, Margin.Bottom(4, Bp.Md))`); bundles Bootstrap 5.3.8 + Bootstrap Icons 1.13.1 as static assets, linked with `BootstrapStyles()`. The guide is split into three pages — this one (setup + content/layout + utilities), navigation & overlays, and forms & inputs (below).
- [Bootstrap navigation & overlays](docs/bootstrap-navigation.md): the controlled, zero-JS interactive components — `BsNavbar`/`BsNav`/`BsNavItem` (SPA-routed, auto-active), `BsTabs`/`BsAccordion`, `BsModal`/`BsOffcanvas` (focus-trapped, Escape-closes), `BsToast`, and `BsDropdown`; all `.dropdown-menu` popovers are re-anchored `position:fixed` while open (opt-in `data-rask-popover`) to escape overflow-clipping ancestors.
- [Bootstrap forms & inputs](docs/bootstrap-forms.md): the `IFormControl<T>`-bound controls — `BsInput`/`BsTextarea`/`BsCheck`/`BsRadioGroup`/`BsCheckboxGroup`, the data-driven combobox `BsSelect`/`BsMultiSelect` (opt-in `Filter` search field, nullable × clear, float-when-filled label, `Native` OS `<select>`; opening focuses the filter and Enter/Esc/arrows stay inside the dropdown — Enter picks without submitting the form), and the hand-editable `BsDatePicker`/`BsTimePicker`/`BsDateTimePicker` calendar/clock controls.
- [Building form controls](docs/building-form-controls.md): end-to-end guide to authoring a custom control with `IFormControl<T>` — the interface, a complete worked example, the default-method helpers, and the bound-vs-controlled / stateless-helper-vs-Component trade-offs.
- [HTTP & files](docs/http-and-files.md): data & file *transfer* — a DI'd `HttpClient` (constructor-injected, `BaseAddress` at the app origin; fetch in `OnMountAsync` with cancel/retry/error handling), the typed file-picker input (`Input(Type: InputType.File, OnFiles:)` + `RaskFile` metadata; multipart on Server, JS chunked reads on WASM), and `Navigator.Download` (event-handler-only; served from `/_rask/download/…` on Server, base64 to JS on WASM).
- [Data access](docs/data-access.md): EF Core + SQLite, IDbContextFactory, loading in the lifecycle, vertical slices, DDD value objects, SQLite decimal gotcha.
- [CQRS](docs/cqrs.md): the opt-in, standalone `Rask.Cqrs` package — a source-generated, reflection-free CQRS/mediator. IQuery<T>/ICommand/ICommand<T>/INotification + their handlers, dispatched via a single IDispatcher — DispatchAsync (one method for queries and commands, response type inferred) and PublishAsync for notifications; register with AddRaskCqrs(). Handlers are wired by a Roslyn generator (no runtime reflection, no assembly scanning, [DynamicDependency]-preserved ctors) so it publishes clean under the WASM/AOT trimmer. Pipeline behaviors (IPipelineBehavior<TRequest,TResult>, registered via AddOpenBehavior / AddBehavior) are the decorator hook for logging/validation/etc; none ship. Notifications fan out Sequential or WhenAll. Diagnostics RASK028 (ambiguous handler) / RASK029 (unregisterable handler). Depends only on Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.Abstractions.
- [Browser APIs](docs/browser-apis.md): the map of all typed Web-API wrappers (43) — shared vs WASM-only, one-shot vs subscription, with the inject-from-ctor pattern and the push/[JSInvokable] mechanism.
- [JS interop](docs/js-interop.md): scoped CSS/JS, element refs, IJSRuntime, typed browser APIs — shared (both transports) in Rask.Core.Browser ( plus the PWA APIs IWebPush/INotifications/IBadge/IWakeLock); WASM-only in Rask.Wasm.Browser (IShare/IScreenOrientation/IFullscreen/IInstallPrompt + device APIs ISerial/IUsb/IHid/IBluetooth/IMediaDevices/IEyeDropper/IPictureInPicture/IIdleDetector).
- [AOT compilation](docs/aot.md): opt-in full WASM AOT via `-p:RaskWasmAot=true` (default keeps the Mono interpreter; needs the wasm-tools workload). A reflection-free `TypedParserRegistry` seeds every BCL `IParsable` primitive and resolves route/query/form string values with no runtime generics; the RoutesGenerator auto-registers custom `IParsable` route/query param types; `RaskBinding.RegisterParsable<T>()` registers custom form-model value types; `InvokeAsync<T>` needs a `JsonSerializerContext` for custom T. Runtime builds under `IsAotCompatible` and the WASM sample under `EnableAotAnalyzer`, so every warnings-as-errors build enforces AOT-safety; the full AOT publish runs nightly. Mono WASM AOT is mixed-mode (interpreter stays), so the win is a clean bundle + faster binding, not crash-avoidance.
- [Mobile & PWA](docs/pwa.md): build installable mobile apps in C#. WASM = full PWA (install, true offline, push, every device API). Server = installable + push-capable via AddRaskPwa (serves manifest + service worker, auto-registers it, emits the manifest link into the server-rendered head), but NOT an offline app (offline navigations show a static offline.html; no background sync; install-prompt + activation-bound device APIs stay WASM-only). Typed Web app manifest (WebAppManifest in Rask.Core.Browser; WASM UsePwa / Server AddRaskPwa), default service worker (rask-sw.js; shared push/notificationclick handlers in Rask.Core), IWebPush + INotifications + IBadge + IWakeLock (Rask.Core.Browser, both hosts), `dotnet new rask-wasm --pwa` / `dotnet new rask-server --pwa`. Sending push from the backend: the opt-in `Rask.WebPush` package (IWebPushSender, VAPID RFC 8292 + aes128gcm RFC 8291, zero external deps).
- [Native mobile (iOS/Android)](docs/native.md): the `Rask.Native` WebView-hybrid host — run a Rask app natively on iOS/Android inside a platform WebView, driven by the SAME render/diff pipeline as Server/WASM (it subclasses LiveSessionBase). Two modes: Native+Local (in-process, offline — `NativeAppHost.RunLocalAsync<App>`) and Native+Server (thin native shell over a remote Rask Server — `ConnectToServer`). The platform WebView is abstracted behind the `INativeWebView` bridge (WKWebView on iOS / android.webkit.WebView on Android), implemented in the app head, so the library builds/unit-tests on plain net10.0 with no iOS/Android workloads. Ships the native client dialect (rask.native.js) + boot shell. Scaffold + run: `dotnet new rask-native`, then `dotnet workload install ios android` and `dotnet build -t:Run -f net10.0-android` (or `-f net10.0-ios`). The `rask-native` template (shared components + Platforms/iOS WKWebView head + Platforms/Android WebView head) ships and runs end-to-end on both platforms; the template's App.cs pads Body by `env(safe-area-inset-*)` (with a viewport-fit=cover viewport) so content clears the notch/status bar. The native client shares the transport-neutral DOM helpers (rAF input/scroll coalescing, keyboard + drag, scoped-CSS FOUC gating) with the Server/WASM clients via common spliced modules (rask-input.js/rask-scoped.js/rask-events.js). `samples/Rask.Example.Native` mounts the same shared showcase App as Server/WASM and is covered by the same E2E net headlessly (no emulator): NativeExampleTests drives the real rask.native.js + RunLocalAsync pipeline in Chromium via a Playwright-backed INativeWebView. Preview / pre-1.0: native device backends (native geo/push/biometrics) are the main remaining follow-up (the scoped-JS invoke gate + file uploads also stay host-specific for now). WebView hybrid (C# runs native, view is a WebView) — not a native-control renderer.
- [Authentication](docs/authentication.md): cookie/JWT, Authorize, route guards.
- [Observability](docs/observability.md): structured logging, the `Rask.Server` meter + activity source, `AddRaskLiveSessions()` health check.
- [Configuration](docs/configuration.md): `RaskLiveOptions` (shared: diff mode, path base, session cap) + `RaskServerOptions` (server-only WS/grace/idle/backpressure limits) + `RaskUploadOptions` (upload size + per-session quota), appsettings binding + startup validation.
- [Accessibility](docs/accessibility.md): ARIA via the `Aria` dictionary, `Role`/`TabIndex`, the `Img` alt-text analyzer (RASK023), and automatic navigation a11y on the Server host (SPA route changes show a progress bar, move focus into the new page's `<main>`, and announce the route via `aria-live`).
- [Migration from Blazor](docs/migration-from-blazor.md): mapping Blazor concepts to Rask.
- [Diagnostics](docs/diagnostics.md): RASK001–031 compile-time diagnostics + fixes, including IDE quick-fixes (lightbulb) for RASK001 (add `required`) and RASK023 (insert `Alt: ""`), shipped in `Rask.Generators.CodeFixes`.
- [Testing](docs/testing.md): the `Rask.Testing` package (`RaskTest.Render(component)` → `RenderedComponent`; `.ClickAsync()`/`.InvokeAsync(handlerId, json?)` dispatch handlers + re-render; `.Html`/`.HandlerId`/`.Attr` query) for in-process component unit tests, plus Playwright E2E patterns.

## Contributing to Rask itself
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): repo conventions for AI assistants + the `.claude/skills/` workflows.
- [Development workflow](docs/development-workflow.md): the format → warnings-as-errors → tests →
  benchmarks → docs → review → PR gate, CI, nightly, analyzers.
- [Code analysis](docs/code-analysis.md): analyzers and adoption.
